download_r2c2_blenderbot_400M: download the R2C2 400M BlenderBot model fine-tuned on BST Tasks to a given datapath
run_download_seekers_model: run the download function to fetch the r2c2_blenderbot_400M seeker model into the data directory
review_download_function: review the download function that delegates to download_with_model_type for the r2c2_blenderbot_400M model
summarize_download_module: summarize the r2c2_blenderbot_400M module which provides a single download entry point for the model
test_download_integration: test the download function by calling it with a datapath and verifying the model files are retrieved
